- Duration: 90 min
- Cooldown: 30 min

 Max Stamina +80

- Cooldown: 30 min

820849.name: Red Bean Sirutteok
820849.description:

820850.description:

820856.name: Moodle Gukbap
820856.description:
The original Moodle Village Gukbap cooked with Big Auntie Wolim's secret recipe. A meat gukbap, or rice stew. A clove of garlic gets rid of the smell of pork while a bit of rice flour thickens the soup and gives it the milky color. It's always voted No.1 in the yearly list of favorite dishes among those who work at the Nampo Shipyard.

 Gives you an immediate boost of Breath EXP.
 Available up to Breath Lv. 40.
- Cooldown: 240 min

- How to Obtain: Craft via a Cooking Utensil in your residence if at least Cooking Artisan 1 with the knowledge of Moodle Gukbap.

※ Caution: Any attempt to cook Moodle Gukbap before learning its knowledge from Wolim will fail—and all ingredients used will be consumed.

- Ingredients:
Rice Flour x2
Cooked Rice x1
Mineral Water x1
Garlic x2
Pork x3

820104.name: Goosefoot Leaf
820104.description:
A natural resource that can be used in Alchemy or Cooking.

 - How to Obtain: Gathered from Goosefoot with bare hands.

820857.name: Dalbeol Gukbap
820857.description:
The original Dalbeol Village Gukbap cooked with Big Auntie Maksoon's secret recipe. A spicy gukbap, or rice stew, made with bracken, goosefoot leaves, and a generous amount of red pepper powder. It's always voted No.1 in the year list of must-have dishes in Dalbeol Village.

 Gives you an immediate boost of Strength EXP.
 Available up to Strength Lv. 40.
- Cooldown: 240 min

- How to Obtain: Craft via a Cooking Utensil in your residence if at least Cooking Artisan 1 with the knowledge of Dalbeol Gukbap.

※ Caution: Any attempt to cook Dalbeol Gukbap before learning its knowledge from Maksoon will fail—and all ingredients used will be consumed.

- Ingredients:
Goosefoot Leaf x2
Cooked Rice x1
Mineral Water x1
Bracken x2
Red Pepper Powder x3

820858.name: Byeot County Gukbap
820858.description:
The original Byeot County Gukbap cooked with Big Bad Auntie Ahryung's secret recipe. A refreshing gukbap, or rice stew, made with the radish and napa cabbage grown in Byeot County. It's always voted No.1 in the yearly list of dishes that fend off fatigue from exhausting farm work.

 Gives you an immediate boost of Health EXP.
 Available up to Health Lv. 40.
- Cooldown: 240 min

- How to Obtain: Craft via a Cooking Utensil in your residence if at least Cooking Artisan 1 with the knowledge of Byeot Gukbap.

- Ingredients:
Napa Cabbage x2 or High-quality Napa Cabbage x1 or Special Napa Cabbage x1

5122.name: Inextinguishable Stone
5122.description:
A strange stone that pierces the darkness with its everlasting radiance. This may sound odd, but there are no ways to craft it with 100% accuracy. It can be crafted on rare occasions based on the information written about the stone after you get the knowledge of Inextinguishable Stone left behind by an unknown alchemist. Children called this stone the Little Sun.

- Usage #1: Craft [Manor] Little Sun

- Usage #2: Craft Runn Light Fragment

721009.name: Stabilized Magical Black Stone
721009.description:
A Calpheonian Alchemist, Gorgath, created a powerful new type of Black Stone. Gorgath was originally looking for a way to purify lifeforms tainted with black energy when he found dark crystals in the bodies of his experiments. He removed the crystals and found a way to stabilize their power.

- You can use this Black Stone to perform guaranteed enhancement on green grade gear enhanced to +13-15.
Stones required for +13 gear: 5
Stones required for +14 gear: 8
Stones required for +15 gear: 13

- Able to Enhance: Main weapon, sub-weapon, awakening weapon, helmet, armor, gloves, shoes (no life skill gear)

- Press RMB to start enhancement

- How to obtain: Dropped from World or Field Bosses
- Durability will decrease by 30 when you enhance with this stone. If a gear is reformed, you will need to use the same type of magic black stone that you would need for the non-reformed version of the gear.

Mystical leaves that multiply in large amounts with an apu apu when plunked in the water with a plop! Miloberry, a fruit seller in Lake Flondor, found out about it when he eavesdropped on the alchemists. You might be able to craft it with the knowledge of Miloberry's Apu Apu Waterstarwort.

- Usage: Craft [Manor] Flondor Pond

- How to Obtain: Perform Alchemy in your residence with the following ingredients

42435.description:
A piece containing some of boss aura. Collect and put them together to obtain a powerful weapon exuding boss aura.

- Usage #2: Exchange with Jetina at all times

While it emanates a resplendent light, its extraordinarily dense make-up makes it difficult to process, and its rather grotesque appearance akin to a monster's eye makes it an unpopular choice as a gemstone. It is rumored to be capable of unleashing rather atrocious powers.

- Crafting Method: Processing (L) - Simple Alchemy

- Usage #1: Craft Dark Red Fang Crystal - Valor

- Materials:
Black Magic Crystal - Valor x1
Kagtunak x1

- Usage#2: Craft Dark Red Fang Crystal - Armor
